ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD and risk-based AML/CFT profiling for all UBOs, directors, and attorneys-in-fact. Screening is required against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN/SSI lists, UK Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu domestic designations. PEPs, including foreign/domestic high-risk public office holders, close associates, and family members, require senior management approval, enhanced monitoring, and source-of-wealth assessment. Suspicious transactions must be reported to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit under the AML/CTF Act. For ISIC 5222 towage and salvage, enhanced due diligence is required on vessel flag, IMO/Lloyd's registry data, insurance beneficiaries, escrow funding sources, ship-to-ship activity, sanctioned ports, cargoes, and salvage awards.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Registry – VFSC Company Registry (vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names may be registered in English, French, or Bislama and must use Latin alphabetic characters. If the requested name is in a non-Latin script, an official romanized transliteration must be submitted and will control. Permitted suffixes include Limited, Ltd., Corporation, Corp., Incorporated, Inc., Société Anonyme, or SA; the name must be distinguishable from every registered or reserved name and must not create confusion with any government body, regulator, state-owned entity, or financial institution.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Cooperative / Credit Union / Savings and Loan
Municipality / Port Authority / Port Vila / Santo / Luganville
Salvage / Towage when combined with a licensed port name without the relevant maritime authority consent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon VFSC name rejection, the applicant must first request written reasons. The applicant may then submit written representations and file an administrative appeal to the VFSC Board of Commissioners under section 7(4) of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. If the Board upholds the rejection, a further judicial review application may be lodged in the Vanuatu Supreme Court within 42 days of the Board's decision. Third-party objections to a reserved name follow the same administrative appeal path.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered-office address may be supplied by a VFSC-licensed registered agent, and a virtual office is acceptable for the legal seat and statutory mail. However, an active ISIC 5222 towage and maritime salvage company is expected by the VFSC and the Vanuatu Maritime Authority to demonstrate operational substance in vessel ownership, chartering, safety management, and emergency response. A pure virtual office without any local operational capacity will materially impair licensing of towage and salvage services.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: A quantified 20%–30% annual risk for an active licensed towage/salvage International Company; heightened to 40% or more where VFSC AML/CTF risk indicators exist, such as uncleared ship-to-ship transfers, sanctioned-port exposure, high-volume third-party escrow money movement, or incomplete UBO source-of-funds documentation. Unannounced physical inspections may be performed under the AML/CTF Act and VFSC regulatory powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu); sections 3-6 (incorporation, registered agent and registered office), 13-15 (share capital and shares), 26-31 (directors and officers), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2009.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution) together with VFSC Form 1 - Application for Incorporation of an International Company and the Declaration of Compliance
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The Act permits incorporation without an initial capital deposit; issued capital is set by the first Board Resolution and may be denominated in any currency. No escrow or capital deposit account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that subject to the Certificate of Incorporation of the Company, the subscription of shares be and hereby is approved, and the directors are authorised to issue and allot the initial shares to the subscribers identified in the Constitution upon payment of the agreed subscription consideration. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be and hereby is established at the offices of the Company's licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be and hereby is appointed Secretary and [Name] be appointed Director, each to serve until removed pursuant to the Articles. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the execution of bank account documentation and the engagement of the registered agent be ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Clearance and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC - Registrar of International Companies (name reservation desk and online registration portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name reservation request for the proposed company name with a 'Limited' suffix; confirm that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to any existing Vanuatu company, protected trademark, or reserved name. Foreign-language names may be reserved with a roman-alphabet transliteration. The reservation is valid for 30 days and may be renewed once.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form (VFSC Form R)
Subscriber identification particulars (passport copy for each subscriber)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, either file a variant name or submit a letter of consent from the prior nameholder together with trademark evidence. If the name is refused as misleading or undesirable, re-file with a revised name and pay a reduced re-search fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Vanuatu (mandatory for every International Company)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscriber executes the Memorandum and Articles of Association under signature or seal, including the company name, limited liability statement, registered office clause, authorised share capital table, and details of initial members and directors. If executed outside Vanuatu, the subscriber's signature must be notarized and apostilled, with a certified English translation if the original is in another language.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registered agent returns the document with drafting comments; amended provisions must be re-executed by the subscriber and renotarized, then resubmitted within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC - Registrar of International Companies (e-Registry filing window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the Application for Incorporation (VFSC Form 1) together with two executed copies of the Memorandum and Articles, a Declaration of Compliance, and consent letters of the registered agent and registered office. The statutory filing fee is remitted by wire transfer or through the VFSC online payment gateway.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (two executed copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried by the Registrar, the registered agent files a supplementary affidavit or an amendment within 21 days to cure the noted defect. The Certificate of Incorporation will not be issued until all objections are resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Statutory Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC - Finance Office and Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon confirmation of the approved application, pay the VFSC incorporation fee and the first annual renewal fee. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company's assigned registration number, date of incorporation, and official seal. The certificate is conclusive evidence that all incorporation requirements have been satisfied.
required_dossiers: Bank wire or payment gateway confirmation of VFSC fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is not matched to the application, provide the funds transfer reference number to the VFSC Finance Office for reconciliation; if the certificate contains clerical errors, apply for a formal certificate correction under VFSC administrative procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Adoption of Organisational Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company (meeting may be held by written resolution or teleconference)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting following incorporation. Adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution approving the subscription and allotment of shares, establishing the registered office at the licensed agent's address in Port Vila, appointing the company secretary and director(s), and ratifying the opening of bank accounts and engagement of the registered agent. Record minutes and execute share certificates for issue to subscribers.
required_dossiers: Share subscription schedule and share certificates
Minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an appointed director is disqualified or not fit for purposes of the Act, re-run the appointment process and file the amended register of directors with the VFSC within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Notifications and Beneficial Ownership Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Company Registrar; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (beneficial ownership records)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the registered agent and registered office details on the VFSC register. File any subsequent change of directors or officers using the prescribed amendment form. Prepare and maintain the register of beneficial owners in accordance with the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) obligations and ensure that the company's corporate records are held at the registered office. No physical office presence in Vanuatu is required for a licensed vessel operations company.
required_dossiers: Register of members and beneficial owners
Share certificate stubs and allotment records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a filing is rejected for incompleteness, submit a written explanation with corrected forms and pay the applicable late or correction fee to the VFSC to regularise the register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Maritime Authority (VMA) - Marine Safety and Maritime Operations Directorate, jointly with the Vanuatu Department of Labour for workplace matters
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Ship Registration (Certificate of Registry) and Maritime Operating Licence for Towage and Salvage Operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection (DEP), Ministry of Climate Change, Port Vila, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Registration and Preliminary EIA Screening. Routine deep-sea towage and emergency salvage operations without fixed shore installations are subject to screening registration and are generally exempt from a full EIA, but wreck-breaking, bunker discharge, or salvage of pollutant cargo within Vanuatu waters will require a Full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with MARPOL 73/78 Annex I, IV, V and VI and the Vanuatu Environment Protection Act [Cap 283]: zero discharge of oily mixtures within Vanuatu territorial waters; oily water discharge permitted only via approved equipment at <15 ppm; garbage and plastic disposal only to port reception facilities; compliance with SOx and NOx emission limits and sulphur content requirements under MARPOL Annex VI.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance for shoreside offices and workshops from Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services; structural load inspection certificates for any mooring, storage or light fabrication facilities; occupational health and safety certification from the Vanuatu Department of Labour under the Employment Act [Cap 160] and Occupational Health and Safety legislation; seafarer certification and vessel manning compliance verified by the Vanuatu Maritime Authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), VAT and Domestic Taxes Unit, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — official portal: https://www.vrevenue.gov.vu; e-filing portal: VRC e-Services; customs clearance platform: ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Register the International Company (IC) with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 240] and obtain the VFSC certificate of incorporation carrying the statutory company registration number. Step 2: If the IC imports goods into Vanuatu or elects voluntary VAT registration, file the prescribed VRC application for a Tax Identification Number (TIN/VAT ID), supplying a certified copy of the VFSC incorporation certificate, evidence of the registered office address in Vanuatu, the director and shareholder register, a bank reference from a Vanuatu-licensed bank, and evidence of the foreign/offshore ownership and control. Step 3: For a purely offshore towage and salvage operation, no domestic income tax registration or VAT registration is required; the IC must annually file the VFSC renewal declaration confirming that no Vanuatu-source domestic business is carried on and pay the fixed VFSC annual registration fee (a regulatory fee, not a tax). Step 4: Where the IC operates Vanuatu-flagged tug or salvage vessels, obtain the vessel registration certificate from the Vanuatu Maritime Authority under the Maritime Act [Cap 131]; this certificate, together with the VFSC certificate, is retained in the export substantiation bundle.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — Vanuatu has no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax regime; the International Company is an extraterritorial exempt entity under section 92 of the International Companies Act [Cap 240], exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, and fees (including VAT) in respect of offshore business. The exemption is territorial: towage and salvage services physically performed on the high seas or outside Vanuatu's 12-nautical-mile territorial sea remain fully outside the scope of Vanuatu taxation; any supply consumed within Vanuatu customs territory would be subject to the standard VAT and customs rules.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Vanuatu because the jurisdiction does not impose income tax and maintains no broad double-tax treaty network. The operative statutory elections are: (1) election to constitute the company as an International Company under Part II of the International Companies Act, recorded in the constitution and effective while IC status is renewed; (2) voluntary VAT registration under section 5 of the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 283] even where turnover is below the compulsory threshold, permitting a VAT-registered IC to claim 0% export zero-rating on qualifying offshore services; (3) contractual election, at each salvage or towage engagement, to perform the service under a standard international form (Lloyd's Open Form, BIMCO TOWHIRE, or a lump-sum salvage contract) with consideration payable in a foreign currency outside Vanuatu, thereby preserving extraterritorial exemption or export zero-rating.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Value Added Tax under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 283], in force since 1 July 2015; administered by the VAT and Domestic Taxes Unit of Vanuatu Revenue and Customs.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 15,000,000 (fifteen million vatu) taxable turnover in any consecutive twelve-month period triggers compulsory VAT registration; the threshold was raised from VUV 1,000,000 under VAT (Exemption and Registration Threshold) legal instruments adopted in the 2019–2021 economic recovery programme; businesses below the threshold may elect voluntary VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, mandatory e-invoicing, or digital stamping regime is currently enacted for VAT. Registered suppliers must issue sequential VAT invoices (paper or PDF) bearing the supplier's VAT/TIN, retain full tax invoices and supporting charter-party and voyage records, and file VAT returns electronically via the VRC e-Services portal at monthly intervals as prescribed. Export declarations are lodged electronically through ASYCUDA World and receive electronic customs release; the absence of digital fiscal stamping does not relieve the registrant of the six-year statutory record-keeping obligation. The export substantiation file must be reproducible in electronic, auditable form for VRC inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT export zero-rating is available where the service is supplied to a non-resident customer and the towage or salvage services are physically performed, or directly consumed, outside Vanuatu, including deep-sea ocean towage, wreck removal, maritime emergency salvage, and ship towage on the high seas or within foreign territorial waters. Eligibility also requires that the Vanuatu supplier retains evidence that the tug or salvage unit departed Vanuatu customs territory (where departure occurs), that the service was rendered to a foreign shipowner, underwriter, or salved-interest, and that consideration is expressed in and settled from a foreign currency. Where an International Company is not VAT-registered, the supply is not 'zero-rated' but is outside the scope of VAT, with tax exemption evidenced by the VFSC certificate and the International Companies Act exemption certificate; voluntary VAT registration permits the IC to substantively claim 0% on the same qualifying offshore services.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document) filed through ASYCUDA World and electronically released by Vanuatu Customs, evidencing the departure of the tug or salvage units from Vanuatu customs territory; where no goods movement occurs because the service was rendered wholly at sea, a certificate of non-lodgement or written VRC Customs confirmation that no export declaration is applicable.

Original or notarised copy of the signed salvage or towage contract (Lloyd's Open Form 2011, BIMCO TOWHIRE, or lump-sum salvage agreement) clearly identifying the foreign shipowner, the salved or towed vessel, the nature of the services, and the international consideration expressed in a foreign currency.

Ocean towage bill of lading, tug voyage order, mate's receipt, sea protest, or electronic voyage record, together with departure and arrival notices and GPS/AIS track logs proving that the tug or salvage assets were physically outside Vanuatu territorial waters during the entire performance of the engagement.

Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Vanuatu-licensed bank, or the corresponding SWIFT MT103 credit advice from the paying foreign bank, confirming receipt of the foreign-currency fee from the non-resident principal; where payment is received outside Vanuatu, the bank-certified receipt of credit into the IC's offshore account must be supplied.

VFSC certificate of incorporation of the International Company and, where applicable, the Vanuatu Maritime Authority ship registration certificate for the tug or salvage vessel, substantiating the extraterritorial tax-exempt character of the operating entity.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC VAT auditors examine export zero-rating claims against the contractual chain, vessel AIS/GPS records, bank payment confirmations, and customs release data. Penalties under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 283] include: a default assessment plus an administrative penalty of up to 100% of the tax shortfall; additional fixed penalties for failure to maintain proper VAT records; and statutory interest accruing on unpaid or clawed-back VAT. Fraudulent export claims and false or misleading statements made to obtain a refund are criminal offences under the Revenue Administration Act and the Customs and Excise Act, carrying on conviction a fine of up to VUV 2,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 10 years. Where the mandatory 180-day foreign-exchange remittance condition is not satisfied, or the transaction is substantiated on paper only, the zero-rating is reversed, VAT at 12.5% is assessed on the gross consideration with interest and penalties, and no export drawback or refund is payable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) is the central bank, currency issuer, and prudential regulator of licensed commercial banks and international banks. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) acts as the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) for AML/CFT supervision and is the registrar of International Companies and international bank licensees under the International Banking Act [Cap 191]. The Vanuatu Maritime Authority (VMA) is the statutory registrar of the international ship registry relevant to tug and salvage vessels.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV, ISO 4217) is managed under an RBV-administered float referenced to a USD-centric trade basket. Vanuatu repealed the Exchange Control Act [Cap 106] in 1997, abolishing administrative exchange-control approvals for non-residents; both current-account and capital-account transactions are thus freely convertible. No capital transfer licence, prior RBV consent, or profit-remittance permit is required for an International Company. Practical frictions are limited to: (i) the thin offshore VUV market (typical two-way spread 50-150 pips at Port Vila); (ii) correspondent-bank de-risking sensitivity in USD clearing; and (iii) FIU reporting of every credit or debit equal to or exceeding VUV 1,000,000 (approximately USD 9,000 under the AML/CFT Act No. 14 of 2022 and VFSC AML/CFT Regulations). An International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is tax-exempt in Vanuatu and may remit dividends, salvage awards, and intercompany settlements offshore without withholding or repatriation quotas.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender, mandatory conversion, or retention ratio for export, towage, or salvage proceeds. A towage and salvage International Company may retain 100% of foreign-currency earnings in an offshore USD/EUR/AUD nostro account. Continuing obligations are informational: inward remittances referencing salvage awards or time-charter hire must (i) be recorded in the IC's annual VFSC registry filing, (ii) reconcile with the VMA vessel registration and bareboat charter endorsement in force, and (iii) carry in SWIFT remittance information the governing contract reference (e.g., TOWCON, TOWHIRE, SALVAGE/LOF 2000). Coastal towage or salvage performed within Vanuatu territorial waters, if any, is outside the permitted offshore scope of an International Company and would require a domestic shipping operating licence; such income, if inadvertently booked, may be subject to reporting to Customs and the VMA under shipping revenue circulars and could expose the IC's tax-exempt status.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited, Port Vila Main Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Offshore USD Nostro and Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Vanuatu) Limited, Port Vila and Luganville Branches

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low. Vanuatu has no statutory licence category for foreign electronic-money institutions or payment fintechs. Non-bank issuance of e-money to Vanuatu residents requires RBV authorisation under the national payment-system oversight framework; no foreign EMI currently holds such authority to maintain VUV client-money balances. International EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Revolut, Currencycloud) therefore cannot serve as the principal treasury bank for a Vanuatu International Company because the IC must evidence substantive corporate presence, an audit trail of accounting records, and a qualifying banking relationship with a licensed VU institution. Recommended architecture: (i) ring-fence the ANZ or BSP Vanuatu account as the compliance-anchor and escrow account; (ii) permit a Tier-1 foreign EMI or e-money wallet to act solely as a payout hop for crew wages, port disbursements, and subcontracted salvage teams; and (iii) ensure every wallet topping is initiated by a SWIFT MT103 credit from the Vanuatu bank so the cross-border chain remains visible to the VFSC and FIU.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is mandatory for all directors and ultimate beneficial owners at a Port Vila or Luganville branch for first-time onboarding at BSP. ANZ permits a hybrid route: original identity documents certified by a recognised notary or ANZ correspondent bank, followed by a scheduled Microsoft Teams video interview with the Port Vila Corporate Banking desk. BRED applies the strictest norm: two-step biometric identity verification in the presence of a BRED officer, with the first appointment in Port Vila and a subsequent telephonic confirmation; foreign notarisation alone is not accepted. No fully remote e-KYC channel exists for International Companies under current VFSC AML/CFT rules; reliance on a foreign bank's KYC file is insufficient unless the Vanuatu bank independently performs enhanced due diligence on the salvor entity and its UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee shareholding or trust structure concealing the ultimate owner of the tug fleet and the salvage award receivables - a beneficial-ownership red flag under the VFSC AML/CFT framework.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO chain-of-title to the vessel: (a) Vanuatu Maritime Authority Vessel Registration Certificate (Form VM-01) in the International Company's name; (b) TOWCON or SALVAGE/LOF contract evidencing the IC as salvor; (c) notarised and apostilled UBO declarations with passport and proof-of-address for each individual; (d) source-of-funds evidence for tug acquisition (ship sale and purchase agreement, bill of sale, mortgage discharge certificate, broker settlement statement); (e) the last 12 months of bank statements for each UBO and the funding entity; (f) the trustee or nominee licence issued by VFSC together with the declaration of trust and settlement deed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound high-value payments originating from high-risk maritime jurisdictions (Turkey, UAE, Nigeria, Indonesia) or from Lloyd's salvage arbitration settlements paid by a third-party shipowner's P&I club without transparent payor-bank references.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (a) Certificates of insurance for the salvage operation issued under Lloyds Standard Form of Salvage with the named escrow agent; (b) the salvage award or arbitrator's interim assessment, or a sealed settlement agreement; (c) P&I club undertaking and cover letter confirming the casualty and award chain; (d) the full banking trail of the award payment, including payor bank SWIFT BIC, originating account title, and the basis of the payor's authority; (e) a voluntary suspicious-transaction clarification filed with the Vanuatu FIU for any single credit equal to or exceeding VUV 1,000,000; (f) confirmation that the payor jurisdiction is not under FATF or EU/UN sanction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media and litigation flags arising from a prior in rem arrest of the towing vessel or from a major casualty claim, causing the bank's sanction-screening engine to return a negative-news or litigation hit.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (a) Certified copy of the court order lifting or discharging the in rem arrest; (b) caveat-withdrawal letter from the arresting party's P&I club; (c) solicitor's undertaking that all arrest-related settlement funds are held to the order of the court or escrow agent; (d) a worldwide corporate-insolvency and pending-litigation search (including WUC search) covering the salvor and its counterparties, dated within 30 days; (e) external-counsel litigation-hold confirmation signed by a qualified Vanuatu barrister; (f) the marine hull and P&I insurer's loss-run statement confirming continuous cover and no unpaid premium.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection and paid-in surplus must arrive by a single-dealing SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer from the parent, ocean fund, or ship financier into the IC's dedicated capital escrow account at ANZ Port Vila (offshore USD book). Field 70 (Remittance Information) must read 'CAPINJ-IC-ISIC5222' and the narrative must state 'Deemed Capital Contribution to Vanuatu International Company for Deep-Sea Tug Acquisition and Salvage Working Capital'. For correspondent-bank routing, the sending bank should use the IMF BPM6/ECB BOP purpose code applicable to the purchase of vessels and acquisition of transport equipment; generic SWIFT purpose codes 'GIFT' or 'REM' must not be used. The receiving bank will require: (i) a notarised board resolution authorising the account, the exact capital amount, and the authorised signatories; (ii) the VFSC International Company Certificate and current registry extract; (iii) a compliance letter from the sending bank confirming that the remitter is not sanctioned and that the funds are sourced from lawful operations; (iv) alignment of the remitter name with the UBO register on file; and (v) an escrow release instruction stating that funds will be released only against the tug's bill of sale, the VMA registration certificate, or a board-approved operational drawdown. Any inbound credit at least VUV 1,000,000 equivalent triggers a 24-hour FIU return by the receiving bank, and funds are not available for application until the source-of-funds confirmation is countersigned and returned on T+3.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements: (i) crew wages, bunker fuel, port dues, and provisions - SWIFT MT103 issued from the BSP or ANZ operating account with remittance code 'OPEX-TOWAGE-IC5222' and an attached payroll or supplier schedule; (ii) settlement of salvage awards to shipowners, P&I clubs, or Lloyd's Open Form arbitrators - executed as a Lloyds Standard Form Wire evidenced by the LOF agreement, the final award or settlement deed, and an MT199 tracer from the beneficiary bank; (iii) acquisition of tugs, tow lines, and heavy-lift equipment - irrevocable commercial letter of credit subject to ICC UCP 600, issued by ANZ's Melbourne branch or BSP's Sydney branch with presentation documents comprising a full set of bills of lading, an IACS-member surveyor's certificate of class, a VMA deletion or bareboat-charter endorsement certificate, and the seller's commercial invoice; (iv) domestic VUV payments - cleared through the RBV interbank real-time gross settlement system by MT101 batch from the designated VUV account; (v) emergency disbursements to subcontracted salvage teams - a pre-authorised standing order with a documented escrow release matrix signed under the IC's 2-of-3 dual-signatory mandate, each drawdown confirmed by SWIFT. Every outbound wire exceeding USD 50,000 must reference the underlying towage, salvage, or purchase contract to ensure traceability before the bank will execute.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards (USD/VUV) with a maximum tenor of 12 months executed with an RBV-authorised dealer (BSP or ANZ Port Vila) limited to firm trade receivables and payables, with no speculative or naked positions permitted.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV or EUR/VUV) with a Vanuatu-licensed commercial bank or its Australian/French parent, documented under a 2014 ISDA master agreement subject to Vanuatu law, to manage timing mismatches between salvage-award receipts and vessel-instalment payments, in each case on a back-to-back underlying cash-flow basis.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV are not permissible; no active offshore NDF market exists for the Vatu, and the RBV does not recognise NDFs as eligible treasury instruments for authorised dealers.

Short-term USD money-market sweeps and overnight Eurocurrency deposits denominated in USD, EUR, or AUD held at the Tier-1 Vanuatu banks, noting that RBV depositor compensation does not extend to non-resident International Company offshore accounts; margin is therefore collateralised against the VMA entry bonding for the tug registry.
Marine hull, war-risk, and salvage-liability hedging is a non-FX programme placed offshore through a Lloyd's of London broker, kept separate from the FX and cash-management platform.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) with Annual License Fee remittance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of up to 10% of annual fee after 30 days; continued non-filing triggers statutory notice and administrative strike-off with dissolution of the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual compliance certificate and beneficial ownership confirmation filing submitted via licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) for onward AML/CFT record-keeping
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit may require agent to report suspected non-compliance to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and impair the company's good standing certificate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of maritime operating license for towage and salvage operations under Vanuatu Maritime Act vessel registration regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Maritime Services Limited (VMSL) / Vanuatu Maritime Safety Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each annual anniversary of the vessel registration or operating license issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs surcharge and risk of suspension of vessel certificate of registry and operating permit until arrears are cleared

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for Vanuatu International Companies; audit may be triggered only by shareholders' special resolution, court order, or Registrar directive
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory GAAP prescribed; IFRS may be adopted voluntarily; books must fairly reflect financial position and transactions

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Registered agent must conduct annual AML/CFT customer due diligence refresh, obtain written confirmation of ultimate beneficial owners, and record any share transfers during the year; no public UBO registry filing is required

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary audit USD 3,000 – 8,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; no operative income tax statute exists, and an International Company (IC) is expressly exempt from all income taxation under Section 57 of the International Companies Act 1992 (as amended).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent 0% effective rate for eligible ICs. Statutory exemption covers income, capital gains, dividend withholding, stamp duty and business licence tax. Offshore towage and salvage revenues (ISIC 5222) sourced outside Vanuatu are outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT. No capital duty on share issuance and no annual filing tax beyond the flat VFSC administration fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return / Annual Licence Fee Statement (International Companies Act 1992, ss. 113-118; VFSC Fee Schedule). No corporate income tax return exists because Vanuatu has no CIT. The mandatory filing is lodged online by the appointed Vanuatu registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) licensing portal (vfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before each anniversary of incorporation. Late lodgement beyond two months triggers late fees; companies in arrears beyond three months are subject to strike-off from the International Company Register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, IC registration number, date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert exact certificate data; legalisation not required for non-resident shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field B - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address in Vanuatu and licensed agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must remain a genuine Vanuatu address; agent acts as AML conduit for non-resident owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field C - Authorised and Paid-up Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Capital schedule, share classes and amounts allotted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement; non-resident ownership in any currency permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field D - Directors and Beneficial Owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial ownership register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All nationalities acceptable; CDD/KYC files must be held by the registered agent under the AML/CFT Act 2014.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field E - Nature of Business and Local Activity Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declared principal activity and certification of no onshore trading in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'deep-sea towage and maritime salvage services outside Vanuatu' precisely to preserve the offshore exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field F - Location of Financial Records
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address where accounting records and underlying contracts are kept.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Records may be held abroad but must be reachable by the VFSC on demand; retention period is 7 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent certifies completion of customer due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must supply passport, source of funds evidence and corporate structure chart.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge (commonly doubling the annual fee), automatic VFSC strike-off with asset disposition under the Act's dissolution provisions, court-ordered reinstatement costs, and fines of up to VT 1,000,000 for false declarations filed by or on behalf of the IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 (as amended), filed via the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority electronic filing system. Applicable only if the IC makes taxable supplies physically performed within Vanuatu (e.g., harbour towage in Port Vila or Luganville); pure offshore deep-sea salvage and international towage are outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly (quarterly only where the Director of Customs approves).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment due by the 25th day of the month following the taxable period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT at the statutory rate (12.5% under the VAT Act 1998 as amended) on taxable supplies made in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Leave zero if towage/salvage contracts are performed outside Vanuatu territorial waters and invoiced to non-residents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable VAT on local purchases attributable to taxable Vanuatu supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs may credit only VAT incurred on costs strictly linked to Vanuatu taxable activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Excess of Box 1 over Box 2 remitted to the Revenue and Customs Authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No payment required if no Vanuatu-source taxable supply is declared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Zero-Rated and Exempt Supplies Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attach schedule of offshore towing and salvage services supplied to foreign principals.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document evidence of physical performance at sea (towage contracts, Lloyds-standard forms, vessel logs) to defend the offshore classification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Default surcharge on unpaid VAT, monthly interest accrual, administrative penalties for late returns, suspension of VAT registration, and criminal fines for wilful non-declaration of Vanuatu-source supplies.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu law imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an IC to non-resident shareholders. Section 57 of the International Companies Act 1992 exempts distributions, and no withholding statute exists. Dividends may be paid in any currency without government consent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreements in force, so no treaty relief or tax-residency certificate (TRC) procedure applies. The 0% rate is automatic and domestic in origin. For bank clearing of large dividends, the paying agent should hold: (i) board minute approving the dividend; (ii) VFSC good-standing extract; (iii) CRS self-declaration for each beneficial owner. Where the shareholder is tax-resident in a jurisdiction with CFC legislation, that jurisdiction may tax the dividend and no Vanuatu certificate will mitigate the foreign charge.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 0% on cross-border royalties and 0% on debt interest. No treaty rates are applicable because no DTA network exists. Payments for towage charter hire, salvage award shares, vessel management fees and marine insurance premiums are likewise free of Vanuatu WHT. Foreign payors must still apply their own domestic source rules to any payment routed through the Vanuatu IC.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no transfer pricing statute and no prescribed Local File or Master File thresholds in Vatu. The functional substitute is the record-keeping obligation under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019: the IC must maintain accounting records and underlying documents for at least 7 years, sufficient to show commercial rationale if a foreign tax administration makes a transfer pricing or CFC adjustment. The practical threshold is therefore any related-party transaction: intercompany towage master agreements, salvage contracts with affiliated underwriters, vessel charter-hire to connected entities, or management fee arrangements should in all cases be evidenced by arm's length contracts, benchmarked pricing, invoices and bank statements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not enact an Economic Substance Regulations statute in the BVI/Cayman style. Substance is instead enforced indirectly: (i) Section 5 of the International Companies Act 1992 prohibits the IC from trading with Vanuatu residents, owning Vanuatu land or soliciting local public investment, thereby confining the IC to genuinely offshore operations; (ii) the AML/CFT Act 2014 obliges the licensed registered agent to verify and hold beneficial ownership and CDD files; (iii) OECD FHTP and FATF reviews expect demonstrable economic activity within the IC regime, and foreign parent jurisdictions apply their own economic substance, GAAR and CFC attribution rules. A towing and salvage IC owning or chartering tugboats must therefore demonstrate real operational substance - contractual negotiation, voyage management, billing, insurance and risk control - beyond the registered agent's address.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Facilitation and Money Laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to conceal profits from the beneficial owner's resident tax authority; laundering towage and salvage revenues received from foreign payors through layered accounts; issuing invoices for fictitious towage services; running cash-intensive marine operations with no audit trail.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu AML/CFT Act 2014 (as amended): money laundering offences carry custodial penalties of up to 20 years and corporate fines of up to VT 100 million; the VFSC may strike off the IC and revoke the registered agent's licence; foreign tax authorities may recover the full evaded tax plus penalties and pursue assets through mutual legal assistance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners face criminal prosecution, asset seizure, extradition under Vanuatu's Mutual Legal Assistance and Extradition arrangements with Australia, New Zealand and the UK, travel bans, senior personal bankruptcy in civil restitution, and joint and several liability for the company's unpaid tax and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Vanuatu IC with no employees, no office beyond the registered agent's address, no board decisions, no books, and no operational control over towage or salvage contracts; appointing nominee directors with no authority or knowledge; permitting the entity to operate solely as a conduit for invoicing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act 1992 (as amended) and VFSC enforcement practice: monetary penalties, director disqualification orders, strike-off, refusal of good-standing certificates and adverse AML classification. Internationally, the regime has on multiple occasions drawn OECD FHTP scrutiny and EU non-cooperative listing criteria, causing correspondent banks to apply enhanced due diligence or de-risk Vanuatu ICs; a shell finding by a foreign court triggers CFC reattribution of all income and penalties of 100% to 200% of tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors are disqualified from office in Vanuatu; controlling shareholders are deemed to have received the entity's income directly and are assessed personally; foreign courts may issue worldwide asset freezing orders and travel restrictions pending restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Beneficial Ownership Concealment and CRS Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to open or update the beneficial ownership file at the registered agent; use of bearer shares or trust chains designed to obscure the ultimate owner; refusal to provide CRS self-certifications or to cooperate with VFSC and foreign tax information exchange requests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the AML/CFT Act 2014 and the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019: fines of up to VT 10 million against the entity and VT 1 million against individual officers; criminal sanctions for false declarations; strike-off of the company. Cross-border, the IC and its agent are exposed to automatic exchange of information (CRS) and exchange of information on request under the OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters, to which Vanuatu is a party.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, imprisonment of up to 10 years for false beneficial ownership declarations, prohibition from acting as a director of any Vanuatu entity, recovery of the costs of the foreign regulatory investigation, and extradition exposure for perjury-type offences in the requesting state.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlawful Onshore Activity and Unlicensed Marine Operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Performing towage or salvage within Vanuatu territorial waters, contracting with Vanuatu-resident port operators or insurers, owning or operating tugboats registered in Vanuatu without the Maritime Administration's approval, or failing to hold required vessel and salvage licensing in the flag state.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of Section 5 of the International Companies Act 1992 renders the offending contract unenforceable in Vanuatu and subjects the IC to fines and strike-off; the Ports and Harbours Act and Maritime legislation impose licence suspension, daily fines and vessel detention; unpaid VAT and business licence liabilities become immediately due with interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised local trading are jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid fines and third-party losses; in serious cases they face criminal negligence charges, exclusion orders from Vanuatu, and personal suit by injured counterparties, including crew injury claims under maritime lien law.
